title: ML package version matrix: bumping a flavor's tested minimum requires pruning requirement selectors that no longer match any in-range version
answers: Matrix generation (set-matrix / flavors job) fails with 'Found unused requirements' after I raised the transformers minimum version
Why does the flavors CI job error when I bump a package minimum in ml-package-versions.yml?
Where are per-version extra pins like peft or pandas selectors defined for the transformers models and autologging matrix?
How do I add or remove a version-conditional requirement for an ML flavor in the cross-version test matrix?
body:
Path: mlflow/ml-package-versions.yml defines per-flavor tested minimum/maximum versions and version-conditional `requirements` selectors (e.g. `"< 4.45": ["peft<0.14.0"]`) for models and autologging; the matrix is built from it and validated by dev/flavors/src/flavors/_matrix.py:validate_requirements.
Rule: `validate_requirements` treats a requirement selector that matches zero candidate versions inside the filtered [minimum, maximum] range as an error. When you advance a flavor's `minimum`, delete any selector whose range now lies entirely below it (the transformers `"< 4.45"` peft pin was removed when minimum moved to 4.45.0). Selectors whose range still overlaps the window (e.g. `"< 4.52": ["peft<0.18.0"]` with 4.45–4.51 available) stay.
Symptom: `set-matrix` and the dependent `flavors` CI job failed with `ValueError: Found unused requirements '< 4.45' for transformers / models`, blocking cross-version matrix generation for every flavor run.
Constraints: Applies when editing version bounds or selectors in ml-package-versions.yml, for both `models` and `autologging` blocks of the same flavor (they share selectors but have separate min/max). Does not apply to selectors that still match in-range versions, nor to `unsupported` entries. Regenerate mlflow/ml_package_versions.py from the YAML (dev/update_requirements.py) rather than hand-editing it, and run `flavors matrix --no-dev` to confirm.
applies: Any edit to a flavor's minimum/maximum or requirement selectors in mlflow/ml-package-versions.yml.
says: The package matrix generation job fails with an unused requirement error after raising minimum versions.
Automated flavor test pipeline fails after updating the minimum supported version of a framework.
Remove obsolete dependency pins that fall completely below our new minimum package version.
Cross-version compatibility matrix builds are blocked by leftover requirement conditions from older releases.
Fix continuous integration failures when bumping minimum library versions in the compatibility test suite.
search: When advancing a flavor's minimum version in mlflow/ml-package-versions.yml, prune any requirement selectors that no longer match candidate versions inside the [minimum, maximum] range to satisfy validate_requirements in dev/flavors/src/flavors/_matrix.py. Selectors that still overlap the version window or entries under unsupported must remain. This applies to both models and autologging blocks when generating matrix definitions for set-matrix and flavors CI jobs. Regenerate mlflow/ml_package_versions.py using dev/update_requirements.py and verify matrix creation with flavors matrix --no-dev.
